caption: The drawing features a single ballet shoe positioned horizontally and viewed from the side, rendered primarily in a dark purple shade with visible shading and highlighting to suggest form and depth. The upper edge of the shoe and the attached ribbons are depicted in a pale, almost white color, and the ribbons are shown laying in a curving, loose manner across the foreground. In the upper right corner of the image, there is a smaller inset sketch of the same shoe viewed from above, drawn in thin, simple lines without color. The main shoe occupies the majority of the bottom left section of the drawing, while the rest of the background is plain and light beige.
title: Slipper
